records.dataset: enwik9 (2048-byte chunks, each coded with no history)
records.size_kind: raw rate: data only; adjusted rate: data + 2 bytes/parameter (float16)
records.bpb_arithmetic: 8 * 8.3% = 0.664 (rate printed to 0.1%, so +-0.004 bpb)
records.notes: LLMs see only the top-100 token log-probs (renormalized), 2048 ASCII chars per chunk, bytes >127 have the MSB zeroed and the lost bit appended; small Transformers are byte-level, trained on enwik8 (enwik9 is partly out-of-distribution). Classical compressors count their header once.
